blocks.zh: 關鍵設計理念
blocks.en: Key Design Philosophies

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Chapter

blocks.zh: 理解製藥用水（Pharmaceutical Water）在藥品製造中的核心地位，以及水質規格對系統全生命週期成本的深遠影響
blocks.en: Understand the central role of pharmaceutical water in drug manufacturing, and how the water quality specification affects the life-cycle cost of the system

blocks.zh: 區分 USP Purified Water（純化水）與 USP Water for Injection（WFI，注射用水）的法規要求差異
blocks.en: Distinguish the regulatory requirements for USP Purified Water from those for USP Water for Injection (WFI)

blocks.zh: 掌握 USP 三階段電導率測試（Three-Stage Conductivity Testing）的邏輯與實務操作
blocks.en: Master the logic and practice of the USP three-stage conductivity test

blocks.zh: 理解 Total Organic Carbon（TOC，總有機碳）測試的原理、儀器類型，及超標處理程序
blocks.en: Understand the principle of Total Organic Carbon (TOC) testing, the types of instruments, and how to handle out-of-limit results

blocks.zh: 掌握 Critical Process Parameters（CPP，關鍵製程參數）的定義與在水系統中的應用
blocks.en: Master the definition of Critical Process Parameters (CPPs) and how they apply to water systems

blocks.zh: 理解 cGMP 合規的核心哲學：規格制定、驗證記錄與微生物控制的三位一體
blocks.en: Understand the core philosophy of cGMP compliance: the trinity of specification, validation records, and microbial control

blocks.zh: 區分 Design Range（設計範圍）、Allowable Operating Range（允許操作範圍）與 Normal Operating Range（正常操作範圍）三者的層級關係
blocks.en: Distinguish the hierarchy of the Design Range, the Allowable Operating Range, and the Normal Operating Range

blocks.zh: 本章導覽
blocks.en: Chapter Overview

blocks.zh: 2.1 Introduction（導論）
blocks.en: 2.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 導師解析
blocks.en: Trainer's Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心概念：製藥用水的戰略地位
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Strategic Role of Pharmaceutical Water

blocks.zh: 製藥用水不是「公用工程」那麼簡單。它是：
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical water is much more than a "utility". It is:

blocks.zh: 最大量使用的原料 — 幾乎所有劑型製造都離不開水
blocks.en: The most heavily used raw material - nearly every dosage form depends on water

blocks.zh: 設備清洗的核心媒介 — CIP（Clean-in-Place，就地清洗）全靠它
blocks.en: The core medium for equipment cleaning - CIP (Clean-in-Place) relies entirely on it

blocks.zh: 成本驅動的關鍵決策 — 水質規格直接決定全生命週期成本
blocks.en: A key cost-driving decision - the water quality specification directly determines life-cycle cost

blocks.zh: 所以這一章開宗明義就告訴你：選錯水質規格，比選錯設備更貴。
blocks.en: So the chapter opens by telling you plainly: choosing the wrong water quality specification costs more than choosing the wrong equipment.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：水質規格如同建築設計等級
blocks.en: Analogy: The Water Quality Specification Is Like a Building Design Grade

blocks.zh: 想像你要蓋房子。如果一開始就指定「抗震9級」，所有建材、結構設計、施工方法都會跟著升級，成本自然飆升。但如果實際需求只需要「抗震7級」，你就白花了一大筆錢。
blocks.en: Imagine building a house. If you specify "magnitude 9 earthquake resistance" from the start, every material, structural design, and construction method has to be upgraded with it, and the cost naturally soars. But if the real need is only "magnitude 7", you have wasted a large sum of money.

blocks.zh: 製藥用水也是一樣：WFI 系統的建置與維護成本遠高於 Purified Water。如果你的產品只需要 Purified Water，卻因為「保守」而選了 WFI，後續的能源、維護、驗證成本會讓你吃不消。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical water works the same way: the cost of building and maintaining a WFI system is far higher than for Purified Water. If your product needs only Purified Water but you chose WFI to be "conservative", the energy, maintenance, and validation costs that follow will overwhelm you.

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞察：「Design Out」的哲學
blocks.en: Key Insight: The "Design Out" Philosophy

blocks.zh: 注意原文用了 "design out, or ensure control of the risk" 這個詞彙。這是 ISPE 一貫的風險管理哲學：
blocks.en: Note the wording in the original text: "design out, or ensure control of the risk". This reflects ISPE's consistent risk management philosophy:

blocks.zh: 首選：設計消除風險（Design Out）— 例如使用熱水循環消除微生物滋生的機會
blocks.en: First choice: eliminate the risk by design (Design Out) - for example, using hot water circulation to remove the opportunity for microbial growth

blocks.zh: 次選：控制風險（Ensure Control）— 例如定期消毒、監控微生物
blocks.en: Second choice: control the risk (Ensure Control) - for example, periodic sanitization and microbial monitoring

blocks.zh: 這與 ICH Q9 的風險控制層級完全一致。
blocks.en: This is fully consistent with the risk control hierarchy in ICH Q9.

blocks.zh: 兩種法定水質（Compendial Waters）
blocks.en: The Two Compendial Waters

blocks.zh: 非法定水（Non-Compendial Waters）如 RO water、DI water，通常以最後一道處理步驟命名。
blocks.en: Non-compendial waters, such as RO water and DI water, are usually named after their final treatment step.

blocks.zh: 2.2 United States Pharmacopoeia (USP)（美國藥典）
blocks.en: 2.2 United States Pharmacopoeia (USP)

blocks.zh: USP 的角色定位
blocks.en: The Role of the USP

blocks.zh: USP（United States Pharmacopoeia，美國藥典）是美國法定的品質標準。它定義了兩種「大宗水」（Bulk Waters）的品質規格：
blocks.en: The USP (United States Pharmacopoeia) is the legally recognized quality standard in the United States. It defines the quality specifications for two "Bulk Waters":

blocks.zh: Purified Water（純化水）
blocks.en: Purified Water

blocks.zh: Water for Injection（注射用水）
blocks.en: Water for Injection

blocks.zh: 注意：USP 還有其他「包裝水」（Packaged Waters）的專論，例如 Sterile Water for Injection，但本指引只關注生產系統中的大宗水。
blocks.en: Note: the USP also has monographs for other "Packaged Waters", such as Sterile Water for Injection, but this guide focuses only on the bulk waters in production systems.

blocks.zh: 版本提醒
blocks.en: Version Reminder

blocks.zh: 本指引撰寫時參照的是 USP 24。現行版本已更新至 USP-NF（持續修訂中）。三階段電導率測試的基本框架未變，但具體限值表應查閱最新版 USP <645> 與 <643>。
blocks.en: This guide was written with reference to USP 24. The current edition has since been updated to the USP-NF (which is continuously revised). The basic framework of the three-stage conductivity test is unchanged, but the specific limit tables should be checked in the latest USP <645> and <643>.

blocks.zh: 2.2.1 USP Purified Water（USP 純化水）
blocks.en: 2.2.1 USP Purified Water

blocks.zh: Purified Water 的五大要件
blocks.en: The Five Requirements for Purified Water

blocks.zh: 想通過 USP Purified Water 的門檻，你的水系統必須同時滿足五個條件：
blocks.en: To meet the USP Purified Water standard, your water system must satisfy all five of the following conditions:

blocks.zh: 原水合格 — 起點必須是符合飲用水法規的「Drinking Water（飲用水）」
blocks.en: Acceptable source water - the starting point must be "Drinking Water" that complies with drinking water regulations

blocks.zh: 不添加物質 — 不得加入防腐劑或其他添加物
blocks.en: No added substances - no preservatives or other additives may be added

blocks.zh: 製程適當 — USP 對 PW 的製程不限制（unlike WFI），只要 "suitable"
blocks.en: Suitable process - the USP does not restrict the process for PW (unlike WFI); it only has to be "suitable"

blocks.zh: 電導率合格 — 依據 USP <645> 三階段測試
blocks.en: Acceptable conductivity - per the USP <645> three-stage test

blocks.zh: TOC 合格 — 依據 USP <643>，限值 500 ppb
blocks.en: Acceptable TOC - per USP <643>, with a limit of 500 ppb

blocks.zh: 比喻：Purified Water 如同「普通駕照」
blocks.en: Analogy: Purified Water Is Like an "Ordinary Driver's License"

blocks.zh: 考普通駕照只要求你會開車、通過筆試和路考。至於你用哪台車來練習、在哪個駕訓班學的，不限制。
blocks.en: For an ordinary driver's license, you only need to show that you can drive and pass the written and road tests. Which car you practiced in and which driving school you attended are not restricted.

blocks.zh: Purified Water 也是如此 — USP 不管你用 RO、EDI、蒸餾、或混合製程，只要最終出水能通過電導率和 TOC 檢測即可。
blocks.en: Purified Water is the same: the USP does not care whether you use RO, EDI, distillation, or a hybrid process, as long as the final water passes the conductivity and TOC tests.

blocks.zh: 2.2.2 USP Water for Injection (WFI)（注射用水）
blocks.en: 2.2.2 USP Water for Injection (WFI)

blocks.zh: WFI = Purified Water + 更嚴格要求
blocks.en: WFI = Purified Water + Stricter Requirements

blocks.zh: WFI 的要求是 Purified Water 的「超集」（superset），額外增加：
blocks.en: The WFI requirements are a "superset" of those for Purified Water, with these additions:

blocks.zh: 製程限制 — 最後一道純化步驟必須是 Distillation（蒸餾）或 Reverse Osmosis（逆滲透）
blocks.en: Process restriction - the final purification step must be Distillation or Reverse Osmosis

blocks.zh: 內毒素限值 — ≤ 0.25 EU/mL（Endotoxin Unit，內毒素單位）
blocks.en: Endotoxin limit - ≤ 0.25 EU/mL (Endotoxin Unit)

blocks.zh: 微生物控制 — 必須採取適當措施最小化微生物生長
blocks.en: Microbial control - appropriate measures must be taken to minimize microbial growth

blocks.zh: WFI 關鍵規格速查
blocks.en: WFI Key Specifications at a Glance

blocks.zh: 法規演進提醒
blocks.en: Regulatory Evolution Reminder

blocks.zh: 本指引撰寫時（2001），USP 只允許蒸餾和 RO 作為 WFI 的最終處理步驟。歐洲藥典（EP）在 2017 年修訂後也接受了非蒸餾方法（如膜法）。但 USP 的規定迄今未變 — 仍然只限蒸餾或 RO。
blocks.en: When this guide was written (2001), the USP allowed only distillation and RO as the final treatment step for WFI. The European Pharmacopoeia (EP) was revised in 2017 and now also accepts non-distillation methods (such as membrane-based methods). However, the USP position remains unchanged to this day - it is still limited to distillation or RO.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，如果客戶的目標市場包含美國，WFI 系統設計必須確保最終步驟是蒸餾或 RO。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, if a client's target market includes the United States, the WFI system must be designed so that the final step is distillation or RO.

blocks.zh: 2.2.3 Non-Monographed but Accepted Requirements（非專論但已接受的要求）
blocks.en: 2.2.3 Non-Monographed but Accepted Requirements

blocks.zh: 隱藏的查核重點
blocks.en: Hidden Inspection Focus Points

blocks.zh: 注意這段看似「參考資訊」的文字，其實暗含多個查核要點：
blocks.en: This passage looks like "reference information", but it actually contains several inspection points:

blocks.zh: "Finally subjected to" — 意味著蒸餾或 RO 必須是最後一步。如果你在 RO 之後又加了一個 UV 殺菌器，那 RO 就不算「最後一步」了嗎？這是一個常見的法規灰色地帶，需要審慎論證。
blocks.en: "Finally subjected to" - this means distillation or RO must be the last step. If you add a UV sterilizer after the RO, does the RO no longer count as the "last step"? This is a common regulatory gray area and needs careful justification.

blocks.zh: 取樣量差異 — USP 說 PW 最小 1 mL，但 FDA 建議 100 mL。實務上，你最好用 FDA 的建議量，因為查廠的是 FDA。
blocks.en: Difference in sample volume - the USP says a minimum of 1 mL for PW, but the FDA recommends 100 mL. In practice, it is best to use the FDA's recommended volume, because the FDA is the one inspecting your site.

blocks.zh: "Supplement the general action guidelines" — 你有責任根據自己的產品制定更嚴格的標準。
blocks.en: "Supplement the general action guidelines" - you are responsible for setting stricter standards based on your own product.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Action Limit 如同「超速罰單門檻」
blocks.en: Analogy: The Action Limit Is Like the "Speeding Ticket Threshold"

blocks.zh: 高速公路限速 110 km/h，但警察通常不會在 111 km/h 開罰。Action Limit 就像是「開始開罰的門檻」— 一旦微生物計數超過這個值，你必須啟動調查程序。
blocks.en: The highway speed limit is 110 km/h, but the police usually will not ticket you at 111 km/h. The Action Limit is like the "threshold at which tickets start": once the microbial count exceeds this value, you must start an investigation.

blocks.zh: 但好的製造商還會設定 Alert Limit（預警限值），就像車上的測速提醒在 100 km/h 就會響起，給你反應時間。
blocks.en: But a good manufacturer also sets an Alert Limit, like the speed warning in a car that sounds at 100 km/h, giving you time to react.

blocks.zh: 2.2.4 USP Testing and Instrument Requirements（USP 測試與儀器要求）
blocks.en: 2.2.4 USP Testing and Instrument Requirements

blocks.zh: 三階段電導率測試的邏輯
blocks.en: The Logic of the Three-Stage Conductivity Test

blocks.zh: 為什麼不直接測一次就好？因為 USP 設計了一套「遞進式」的測試邏輯，目的是減少不必要的 Off-Line 測試，同時確保判定的嚴謹性：
blocks.en: Why not just test once? Because the USP designed a "progressive" testing logic whose purpose is to reduce unnecessary off-line testing while keeping the pass/fail decision rigorous:

blocks.zh: Stage 1（線上初篩）：在操作溫度下即時測量。若 ≤ 溫度對應限值（通常以 2.1 μS/cm 作為安全簡化判定），直接 PASS。大多數情況在此就結束。
blocks.en: Stage 1 (in-line screening): measure in real time at the operating temperature. If the reading is ≤ the limit for that temperature (a value of 2.1 μS/cm is commonly used as a safe simplified criterion), it is an immediate PASS. Most cases end here.

blocks.zh: Stage 2（離線確認）：如果 Stage 1 未通過，取樣後在 25°C ±1°C 下重測。這排除了溫度影響的變異。
blocks.en: Stage 2 (off-line confirmation): if Stage 1 is not passed, take a sample and retest at 25°C ±1°C. This removes the variation caused by temperature.

blocks.zh: Stage 3（最終判定）：如果 Stage 2 仍未通過，加入 KCl 溶液測 pH（5-7 範圍）。如果 pH 超出範圍或電導率仍超標 → FAIL。
blocks.en: Stage 3 (final determination): if Stage 2 is still not passed, add KCl solution and measure the pH (range 5-7). If the pH is out of range or the conductivity still exceeds the limit → FAIL.

blocks.zh: 比喻：三階段測試像醫院分診
blocks.en: Analogy: The Three-Stage Test Is Like Hospital Triage

blocks.zh: 去急診室：
blocks.en: At the emergency room:

blocks.zh: Stage 1（護士站）：量體溫、血壓。正常？回家。
blocks.en: Stage 1 (nurses' station): temperature and blood pressure are taken. Normal? Go home.

blocks.zh: Stage 2（診間）：體溫偏高，抽血確認。沒事？回家。
blocks.en: Stage 2 (consulting room): temperature is slightly high, so blood is drawn to confirm. Nothing wrong? Go home.

blocks.zh: Stage 3（專科檢查）：血液指標異常，做更深入的檢查。確認有問題 → 住院。
blocks.en: Stage 3 (specialist examination): blood markers are abnormal, so deeper examination follows. A problem is confirmed → admission.

blocks.zh: 同理，三階段測試的哲學是：能在簡單的步驟就判定合格，就不浪費資源做複雜測試。
blocks.en: Likewise, the philosophy of the three-stage test is: if a simple step can establish acceptability, do not waste resources on complex testing.

blocks.zh: 電導率儀器精度要求速查
blocks.en: Conductivity Instrument Accuracy Requirements at a Glance

blocks.zh:
Temperature accuracy:      ± 0.25°C
Conductivity resolution:   < ± 0.1 μS/cm
Cell constant accuracy:    ± 2%
Reading accuracy:          < ± 0.1 μS/cm

Key rule: 非溫度補償測量（Non-temperature-compensated）
         → 不可使用儀器的自動溫度補償功能！
blocks.en:
Temperature accuracy:      ± 0.25°C
Conductivity resolution:   < ± 0.1 μS/cm
Cell constant accuracy:    ± 2%
Reading accuracy:          < ± 0.1 μS/cm

Key rule: Non-temperature-compensated measurement
         → Do NOT use the instrument's automatic temperature compensation function!

blocks.zh: 實務陷阱：In-Line 電導率計的安裝位置
blocks.en: Practical Pitfall: Where to Install the In-Line Conductivity Meter

blocks.zh: 原文明確指出最佳位置：最後一個使用點（point of use）閥門之後、儲槽回水口之前。
blocks.en: The original text clearly states the best location: after the last point-of-use valve and before the return to the storage tank.

blocks.zh: 為什麼？因為這個位置代表「系統中水質最差的點」— 水跑完整個迴路、經過所有使用點之後的狀態。如果這裡合格，其他點一定合格。
blocks.en: Why? Because this location represents "the worst water quality in the system" - the state of the water after it has traveled the entire loop and passed every point of use. If the water is acceptable here, every other point must be acceptable too.

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤：把電導率計裝在儲槽出水口 — 這只代表「剛出發」的水質，不代表「跑完全程」的水質。
blocks.en: Common mistake: installing the conductivity meter at the tank outlet. This only represents the water quality "at the start of the journey", not the quality after "the full trip".

blocks.zh: 2.2.5 Total Organic Carbon (TOC) and Requirements for TOC Control（總有機碳及其控制要求）
blocks.en: 2.2.5 Total Organic Carbon (TOC) and Requirements for TOC Control

blocks.zh: TOC 的本質：間接量測有機污染
blocks.en: The Nature of TOC: An Indirect Measure of Organic Contamination

blocks.zh: TOC（Total Organic Carbon，總有機碳）不是直接測有機物本身，而是：
blocks.en: TOC (Total Organic Carbon) does not measure the organic compounds directly. Instead:

blocks.zh: 將有機分子完全氧化為 CO2
blocks.en: Organic molecules are completely oxidized to CO2

blocks.zh: 測量產生的 CO<sub>2</sub> 量
blocks.en: The amount of CO<sub>2</sub> produced is measured

blocks.zh: 扣除無機碳（IC，Inorganic Carbon — 來自溶解的 CO<sub>2</sub> 和碳酸氫鹽）
blocks.en: Inorganic carbon (IC, from dissolved CO<sub>2</sub> and bicarbonate) is subtracted

blocks.zh: 剩下的就是有機碳的量
blocks.en: What remains is the amount of organic carbon

blocks.zh: 公式：TOC = TC - IC（Total Carbon - Inorganic Carbon）
blocks.en: Formula: TOC = TC - IC (Total Carbon - Inorganic Carbon)

blocks.zh: TOC 規格速查
blocks.en: TOC Specifications at a Glance

blocks.zh:
USP TOC limit:          ≤ 500 ppb (0.5 mg/L)
Detection limit:        ≤ 0.05 mg/L (50 ppb)
Signal-to-noise ratio:  limit / LOD = 10:1

TOC = TC - IC
TC  = Total Carbon（總碳）
IC  = Inorganic Carbon（無機碳，源自溶解 CO2 / HCO3-）
blocks.en:
USP TOC limit:          ≤ 500 ppb (0.5 mg/L)
Detection limit:        ≤ 0.05 mg/L (50 ppb)
Signal-to-noise ratio:  limit / LOD = 10:1

TOC = TC - IC
TC  = Total Carbon
IC  = Inorganic Carbon (from dissolved CO2 / HCO3-)

blocks.zh: 比喻：TOC 測試像酒駕檢測
blocks.en: Analogy: A TOC Test Is Like a Drink-Driving Check

blocks.zh: 警察路檢酒駕時，不是直接分析你血液中的每一種酒精分子，而是用呼氣測試測你吐出的酒精含量（間接指標）。
blocks.en: When police run a roadside drink-driving check, they do not analyze every alcohol molecule in your blood. They use a breath test to measure the alcohol in your exhaled breath (an indirect indicator).

blocks.zh: TOC 也是類似邏輯：不去鑑定水中到底有哪些有機物（那太複雜了），而是把所有有機物「燒成」CO<sub>2</sub>，用一個數字代表總污染量。
blocks.en: TOC follows similar logic: instead of identifying exactly which organic compounds are in the water (far too complicated), it "burns" all organics into CO<sub>2</sub> and uses a single number to represent the total contamination.

blocks.zh: 超標尖峰（Spike）的處理哲學
blocks.en: Philosophy for Handling Out-of-Limit Spikes

blocks.zh: In-Line TOC 監控中偶爾會出現突然飆高又迅速回到正常的「尖峰」。ISPE 的建議是：
blocks.en: In-line TOC monitoring occasionally shows a sudden spike that quickly returns to normal. ISPE's recommendation is:

blocks.zh: 必須調查 — 每一次超標都必須有正式的書面說明
blocks.en: Investigation required - every excursion must have a formal written explanation

blocks.zh: 可以免查 — 如果尖峰前後都是連續合格讀數，且已建立 SOP 允許此類情境
blocks.en: Investigation may be waived - if the readings before and after the spike are continuously acceptable and an SOP permitting this situation is in place

blocks.zh: 延長取樣週期 — 從短週期（如 5 分鐘）改為 30-60 分鐘，用統計平均來抹平雜訊
blocks.en: Extend the sampling interval - change from a short interval (such as 5 minutes) to 30-60 minutes, using statistical averaging to smooth out the noise

blocks.zh: 這體現了「基於科學的風險管理」而非「零容忍」的監管哲學。
blocks.en: This reflects a regulatory philosophy of "science-based risk management" rather than "zero tolerance".

blocks.zh: 2.2.6 USP 23 Microbial and Endotoxin Testing（微生物與內毒素測試）
blocks.en: 2.2.6 USP 23 Microbial and Endotoxin Testing

blocks.zh: 微生物與內毒素取樣的關鍵原則
blocks.en: Key Principle for Microbial and Endotoxin Sampling

blocks.zh: 這段話很短，但暗含一個重要原則：取樣必須在使用點（Point of Use，POU）。
blocks.en: This passage is short, but it implies an important principle: sampling must be done at the Point of Use (POU).

blocks.zh: 為什麼不在儲槽或製水機出口取樣就好？因為：
blocks.en: Why not just sample at the storage tank or the generator outlet? Because:

blocks.zh: 微生物可能在配送管路中繁殖（尤其是死水腿、低流速區域）
blocks.en: Microorganisms can multiply in the distribution piping (especially in dead legs and low-flow areas)

blocks.zh: Endotoxin（內毒素）可能累積在管壁生物膜（Biofilm，生物膜）上
blocks.en: Endotoxin can accumulate in the biofilm on pipe walls

blocks.zh: 使用點才代表「產品實際接觸到的水質」
blocks.en: The point of use represents "the water quality the product actually contacts"

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見問題
blocks.en: Common CDMO Issue

blocks.zh: 很多 CDMO 的水系統使用點很多（20-50 個），不可能每天全測。實務作法是建立輪替取樣計畫（Rotating Sampling Plan），確保每個 POU 在一個週期（通常一週或一個月）內至少被取樣一次，加上每天固定測幾個「代表性」點位。
blocks.en: Many CDMO water systems have a large number of points of use (20-50), so testing all of them every day is not possible. The practical approach is to establish a Rotating Sampling Plan, ensuring that every POU is sampled at least once within a cycle (usually one week or one month), plus a few fixed "representative" points tested every day.

blocks.zh: 2.2.7 USP 23 pH Testing（pH 測試）
blocks.en: 2.2.7 USP 23 pH Testing

blocks.zh: pH 測試只在 Stage 3 才需要
blocks.en: pH Testing Is Required Only at Stage 3

blocks.zh: pH 不是獨立的常規測試項目，它只在電導率三階段測試走到 Stage 3 時才會啟動。邏輯鏈：
blocks.en: pH is not an independent routine test. It is triggered only when the three-stage conductivity test reaches Stage 3. The logic chain:

blocks.zh: Stage 1 FAIL → 進入 Stage 2
blocks.en: Stage 1 FAIL → proceed to Stage 2

blocks.zh: Stage 2 FAIL → 進入 Stage 3
blocks.en: Stage 2 FAIL → proceed to Stage 3

blocks.zh: Stage 3：測電導率 AND 測 pH（5-7）
blocks.en: Stage 3: measure conductivity AND pH (5-7)

blocks.zh: 任一不合格 → 水不合格
blocks.en: Failure of either one → the water fails

blocks.zh: 為什麼 pH 範圍是 5-7？
blocks.en: Why Is the pH Range 5-7?

blocks.zh: 純水的理論 pH 是 7.0，但因為空氣中 CO<sub>2</sub> 溶入水中形成碳酸，實際 pH 會偏低（約 5.5-6.5）。範圍設在 5-7 就是允許這種「自然偏酸」的現象，同時排除嚴重污染（pH < 5 可能代表酸性污染物，pH > 7 可能代表鹼性殘留）。
blocks.en: The theoretical pH of pure water is 7.0, but because CO<sub>2</sub> from the air dissolves in the water to form carbonic acid, the actual pH tends to be lower (about 5.5-6.5). Setting the range at 5-7 allows for this "natural acidity" while excluding serious contamination (a pH < 5 may indicate acidic contaminants, and a pH > 7 may indicate alkaline residues).

blocks.zh: 2.2.8 Validated Backup Instrumentation（經驗證的備用儀器）
blocks.en: 2.2.8 Validated Backup Instrumentation

blocks.zh: 「備援」不是可選的，是必要的
blocks.en: A "Backup" Is Not Optional; It Is Required

blocks.zh: ISPE 的邏輯很清楚：
blocks.en: ISPE's logic is very clear:

blocks.zh: In-Line 儀器一定會壞 → 必須有校準過的實驗室儀器作為備用
blocks.en: In-line instruments will fail at some point → a calibrated laboratory instrument must be available as a backup

blocks.zh: 實驗室主要儀器也可能壞 → 必須有第二台校準好的備用儀器
blocks.en: The primary laboratory instrument may also fail → a second calibrated backup instrument is needed

blocks.zh: 驗證範圍必須包含「用備用儀器操作」的模式
blocks.en: The validation scope must include operation "using the backup instrument"

blocks.zh: 換句話說：你的驗證計畫必須回答「如果 In-Line 電導率計壞了，我怎麼證明水還是合格的？」
blocks.en: In other words: your validation program must answer the question "If the in-line conductivity meter fails, how do I demonstrate that the water is still acceptable?"

blocks.zh: 比喻：飛機的雙引擎設計
blocks.en: Analogy: The Twin-Engine Aircraft

blocks.zh: 商業客機為什麼要兩具引擎？不是因為常常壞，而是因為一旦壞了後果太嚴重。水系統的備用儀器邏輯完全一樣 — 你不能因為「很少壞」就不準備備援方案。
blocks.en: Why do commercial airliners have two engines? Not because engines fail often, but because the consequences would be too severe if one did. The logic of backup instruments in a water system is exactly the same - you cannot skip a backup plan just because failures are "rare".

blocks.zh: 2.3 Specification of Pharmaceutical Water Quality（製藥用水品質規格的制定）
blocks.en: 2.3 Specification of Pharmaceutical Water Quality

blocks.zh: 核心觀點：USP 是「最低標準」，不是「最佳標準」
blocks.en: Core Point: The USP Is the "Minimum Standard", Not the "Best Standard"

blocks.zh: 這是整章最重要的一句話。很多工程師犯的錯誤是：「我的水符合 USP，所以沒問題。」
blocks.en: This is the most important sentence in the chapter. Many engineers make the mistake of thinking "My water meets the USP, so there is no problem."

blocks.zh: 錯！USP 只定義了最低門檻。根據你的產品特性，你可能需要：
blocks.en: Wrong! The USP defines only the minimum threshold. Depending on your product, you may need:

blocks.zh: 更低的電導率（例如某些生物製劑需要 < 0.5 μS/cm）
blocks.en: Lower conductivity (for example, some biologics require < 0.5 μS/cm)

blocks.zh: 更低的 TOC（例如某些 API 合成需要 < 100 ppb）
blocks.en: Lower TOC (for example, some API syntheses require < 100 ppb)

blocks.zh: 更低的微生物限值（例如 < 1 CFU/100 mL）
blocks.en: Lower microbial limits (for example, < 1 CFU/100 mL)

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO（Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization），你面臨的挑戰比一般藥廠更複雜：
blocks.en: As a CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization), you face challenges that are more complex than those of a typical pharmaceutical company:

blocks.zh: 多客戶、多產品 — 不同客戶可能有不同的水質要求
blocks.en: Multiple clients, multiple products - different clients may have different water quality requirements

blocks.zh: 最嚴格規格原則 — 通常建議系統設計以「最嚴格的客戶規格」為基準
blocks.en: Strictest-specification principle - it is generally recommended to design the system to the "strictest client specification"

blocks.zh: 文件彈性 — 在 Quality Agreement 中明確約定水質規格，避免後續爭議
blocks.en: Documentation flexibility - define the water quality specification explicitly in the Quality Agreement to avoid later disputes

blocks.zh: 成本分攤 — 如果某客戶要求超規格水質（如 bioburden < 1 CFU/100 mL），應在合約中反映額外成本
blocks.en: Cost allocation - if a client requires above-specification water quality (such as bioburden < 1 CFU/100 mL), the additional cost should be reflected in the contract

blocks.zh: 比喻：水質規格如同食材等級
blocks.en: Analogy: The Water Quality Specification Is Like Ingredient Grades

blocks.zh: 米其林餐廳用的牛肉和路邊攤用的牛肉，都要通過食品安全檢驗（= USP 最低標準），但米其林餐廳會額外要求產地、部位、熟成天數等更高規格。
blocks.en: The beef used by a Michelin-starred restaurant and the beef used by a street stall both have to pass food safety inspection (= the USP minimum standard), but the Michelin restaurant additionally demands higher specifications for origin, cut, and aging days.

blocks.zh: 製藥也一樣：USP 只保證「安全」，但「最佳品質」需要製造商自己根據產品需求制定更高標準。
blocks.en: Pharmaceuticals are the same: the USP guarantees only "safety", but "best quality" requires the manufacturer to set higher standards based on the needs of its own product.

blocks.zh: 2.4 Critical Process Parameters（關鍵製程參數）
blocks.en: 2.4 Critical Process Parameters

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞察：微生物的「看不見」困境
blocks.en: Key Insight: The "Invisible" Problem of Microorganisms

blocks.zh: 原文點出一個深刻的真相：微生物品質無法即時監控。傳統的平板計數法需要 48-72 小時才能出結果。這意味著：
blocks.en: The original text points out a profound truth: microbial quality cannot be monitored in real time. The traditional plate count method takes 48-72 hours to give a result. This means:

blocks.zh: 你不可能「即時拒絕」微生物超標的水
blocks.en: You cannot "reject immediately" water that exceeds microbial limits

blocks.zh: 你只能靠替代指標（Surrogate Parameters）來間接控制 — 溫度、UV、臭氧等
blocks.en: You can only control it indirectly through surrogate parameters - temperature, UV, ozone, and so on

blocks.zh: 這些替代指標就成了 CPP — 因為你靠它們來「預測」微生物品質
blocks.en: These surrogate parameters become CPPs, because you rely on them to "predict" microbial quality

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼水系統的 CPP 清單中，大部分都是「微生物控制相關」的參數。
blocks.en: This is why most of the CPPs on a water system's CPP list are "microbial-control-related" parameters.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Thought Exercise

blocks.zh: 假設你的 WFI 系統是 80°C 熱水循環系統。請回答：
blocks.en: Suppose your WFI system is an 80°C hot water circulation system. Answer the following:

blocks.zh: 「循環水溫度」是不是 CPP？為什麼？
blocks.en: Is the "circulating water temperature" a CPP? Why?

blocks.zh: 如果溫度從 80°C 降到 70°C，需要啟動偏差調查嗎？
blocks.en: If the temperature drops from 80°C to 70°C, does a deviation investigation need to be started?

blocks.zh: 「儲槽液位」算不算 CPP？
blocks.en: Is the "storage tank level" a CPP?

blocks.zh: 提示：回顧 CPP 的定義 — 「直接影響水質」。溫度直接影響微生物控制，所以是 CPP。液位不直接影響水質（但間接影響流速和停滯風險），因此通常不列為 CPP，而是 KPP（Key Process Parameter）。
blocks.en: Hint: go back to the definition of a CPP, "directly affects water quality". Temperature directly affects microbial control, so it is a CPP. Level does not directly affect water quality (although it indirectly affects flow velocity and stagnation risk), so it is usually not classified as a CPP but as a KPP (Key Process Parameter).

blocks.zh: CPP 在水系統中的定義
blocks.en: Definition of a CPP in a Water System

blocks.zh: Critical Process Parameter（CPP，關鍵製程參數）是直接影響水質的參數。注意「直接」這個詞 — 間接影響的參數不算 CPP。
blocks.en: A Critical Process Parameter (CPP) is a parameter that directly affects water quality. Note the word "directly" - parameters with only an indirect effect are not CPPs.

blocks.zh: 水系統的典型 CPP 包括：
blocks.en: Typical CPPs for a water system include:

blocks.zh: 2.5 cGMP Compliance Issues（cGMP 合規議題）
blocks.en: 2.5 cGMP Compliance Issues

blocks.zh: 顛覆性觀點：技術不是最重要的
blocks.en: A Surprising View: Technology Is Not the Most Important Factor

blocks.zh: 這段話可能讓很多工程師驚訝：ISPE 說「安裝品質、取樣程序、操作維護、記錄保存往往比你選擇的淨水技術更重要」。
blocks.en: This passage may surprise many engineers: ISPE says that installation quality, sampling procedures, operation and maintenance, and record keeping are often more important than the purification technology you choose.

blocks.zh: 換句話說：一套用 RO + EDI 的系統，如果操作維護做得差，可能比一套只用蒸餾的系統更容易出問題。cGMP 合規的核心不在技術，在管理。
blocks.en: In other words, a system using RO + EDI that is poorly operated and maintained may be more problem-prone than a distillation-only system. The core of cGMP compliance lies not in technology but in management.

blocks.zh: 微生物控制六大措施
blocks.en: Six Measures for Microbial Control

blocks.zh: ISPE 列出的六項措施，本質上都是在回答同一個問題：如何讓微生物無法定居和繁殖？
blocks.en: The six measures listed by ISPE are all, in essence, answers to the same question: how do you stop microorganisms from colonizing and multiplying?

blocks.zh: 連續湍流（Continuous Turbulent Flow）— 讓水永遠在動，微生物沒有「安家」的機會
blocks.en: Continuous turbulent flow - keep the water always moving so microorganisms have no chance to "settle in"

blocks.zh: 溫度控制（Elevated/Reduced Temperatures）— 65-80°C 熱水或 < 4°C 冷水，超出微生物舒適區
blocks.en: Temperature control (Elevated/Reduced Temperatures) - 65-80°C hot water or < 4°C cold water, outside the microbial comfort zone

blocks.zh: 光滑表面（Smooth, Clean Surfaces）— Ra ≤ 0.8 μm 的電解拋光不銹鋼，減少生物膜附著
blocks.en: Smooth surfaces (Smooth, Clean Surfaces) - electropolished stainless steel with Ra ≤ 0.8 μm to reduce biofilm attachment

blocks.zh: 頻繁消毒（Frequent Sanitizing）— 定期化學或熱消毒
blocks.en: Frequent sanitizing (Frequent Sanitizing) - periodic chemical or thermal sanitization

blocks.zh: 正壓維持（Positive Pressure）— 防止外部空氣（帶菌）進入系統
blocks.en: Positive pressure (Positive Pressure) - prevents outside air (carrying microorganisms) from entering the system

blocks.zh: 系統完整性（Properly Designed System）— 消除死水腿、避免低點積水
blocks.en: System integrity (Properly Designed System) - eliminate dead legs and avoid low points where water can pool

blocks.zh: 比喻：微生物控制如同防蟲害
blocks.en: Analogy: Microbial Control Is Like Pest Control

blocks.zh: 想像你要保持一個食品倉庫無蟲害：
blocks.en: Imagine keeping a food warehouse free of pests:

blocks.zh: 保持空氣流通（= 連續湍流）
blocks.en: Keep the air moving (= continuous turbulent flow)

blocks.zh: 溫度控制在蟲子不喜歡的範圍（= 熱水循環）
blocks.en: Hold the temperature in a range pests dislike (= hot water circulation)

blocks.zh: 牆壁光滑無縫隙（= 電解拋光表面）
blocks.en: Smooth walls with no crevices (= electropolished surfaces)

blocks.zh: 定期噴灑殺蟲劑（= 消毒程序）
blocks.en: Spray insecticide regularly (= sanitization procedures)

blocks.zh: 門窗緊閉、正壓送風（= 正壓維持）
blocks.en: Keep doors and windows closed and supply air at positive pressure (= positive pressure maintenance)

blocks.zh: 不留食物殘渣（= 消除營養源累積）
blocks.en: Leave no food residue (= eliminate accumulation of nutrient sources)

blocks.zh: 邏輯完全相同，只是尺度從巨觀變成了微觀。
blocks.en: The logic is exactly the same; only the scale changes, from macroscopic to microscopic.

blocks.zh: 重要警告：品質提升不一定是全面的
blocks.en: Important Warning: Quality Improvement Is Not Necessarily Across the Board

blocks.zh: 原文最後一句很關鍵：「提升一個品質屬性（如電導率）不一定會同時提升另一個（如微生物）」。
blocks.en: The last sentence of the original text is key: "improving one quality attribute (such as conductivity) does not necessarily improve another (such as microbial quality)".

blocks.zh: 舉例：加一台混床離子交換器（Mixed Bed，MB）可以把電導率降到極低，但如果管理不善，樹脂床反而會成為微生物的溫床。你必須從系統整體來看水質，不能只優化單一指標。
blocks.en: For example, adding a mixed bed (MB) ion exchanger can reduce conductivity to a very low level, but if it is poorly managed, the resin bed can instead become a breeding ground for microorganisms. You must look at water quality from the perspective of the whole system, and not optimize a single indicator alone.

blocks.zh: 2.6 Design Range versus Operating Range（設計範圍 vs 操作範圍）
blocks.en: 2.6 Design Range versus Operating Range

blocks.zh: 三層範圍的層級關係
blocks.en: The Hierarchy of the Three Ranges

blocks.zh: 這是本章最重要的概念之一。三個範圍形成一個嵌套關係（Nested Relationship）：
blocks.en: This is one of the most important concepts in the chapter. The three ranges form a nested relationship:

blocks.zh: Design Range（設計範圍）— 最寬
blocks.en: Design Range - the widest

blocks.zh: Allowable Operating Range（允許操作範圍）— 驗證範圍
blocks.en: Allowable Operating Range - the validated range

blocks.zh: Normal Operating Range（正常操作範圍）— 最窄
blocks.en: Normal Operating Range - the narrowest

blocks.zh: 電導率範圍實例（來自原文）
blocks.en: Conductivity Range Example (from the Original Text)

blocks.zh:
Design Condition:           ≤ 0.5 μS/cm  (2.0 MΩ·cm)
                            ↑ 設備供應商的保證值

Allowable Operating Range:  ≤ 1.3 μS/cm  (0.77 MΩ·cm)
                            ↑ 驗證確認的合格範圍

Normal Operating Range:     ≤ 1.0 μS/cm  (1.0 MΩ·cm)
                            ↑ 日常操作的舒適區

USP Stage 1 Limit @ 25°C:  ≤ 1.3 μS/cm
                            ↑ 法規最低要求
blocks.en:
Design Condition:           ≤ 0.5 μS/cm  (2.0 MΩ·cm)
                            ↑ Value guaranteed by the equipment supplier

Allowable Operating Range:  ≤ 1.3 μS/cm  (0.77 MΩ·cm)
                            ↑ Acceptable range confirmed by validation

Normal Operating Range:     ≤ 1.0 μS/cm  (1.0 MΩ·cm)
                            ↑ Comfort zone for day-to-day operation

USP Stage 1 Limit @ 25°C:  ≤ 1.3 μS/cm
                            ↑ Regulatory minimum requirement

blocks.zh: 比喻：高速公路行車速度
blocks.en: Analogy: Highway Driving Speed

blocks.zh: 把三個範圍想像成高速公路行車：
blocks.en: Think of the three ranges in terms of highway driving:

blocks.zh: Design Range（設計範圍） = 車子的設計極速 200 km/h — 工程師設計車子時的性能目標
blocks.en: Design Range = the car's design top speed of 200 km/h - the performance target when engineers designed the car

blocks.zh: Allowable Operating Range（允許操作範圍） = 法定速限 110 km/h — 超過就違規（偏差）
blocks.en: Allowable Operating Range = the legal speed limit of 110 km/h - exceeding it is a violation (deviation)

blocks.zh: Normal Operating Range（正常操作範圍） = 你的巡航速度 90-100 km/h — 保留安全餘裕
blocks.en: Normal Operating Range = your cruising speed of 90-100 km/h - leaving a safety margin

blocks.zh: 為什麼不直接開在速限邊緣？因為路況變化（= 進水品質波動）可能讓你瞬間超速（= 超出 Allowable Range），所以你需要「緩衝區」。
blocks.en: Why not drive right at the limit? Because changing road conditions (= fluctuations in feed water quality) could push you over the limit in an instant (= outside the Allowable Range), so you need a "buffer zone".

blocks.zh: 你的 WFI 系統電導率在正常情況下穩定在 0.8 μS/cm。某天突然升到 1.2 μS/cm，但仍在 USP 限值（1.3 μS/cm）以內。請回答：
blocks.en: Your WFI system conductivity is normally stable at 0.8 μS/cm. One day it suddenly rises to 1.2 μS/cm, but is still within the USP limit (1.3 μS/cm). Answer the following:

blocks.zh: 這算不算偏差（Deviation）？
blocks.en: Is this a deviation?

blocks.zh: 你的 Alert Limit 和 Action Limit 應該設在哪裡？
blocks.en: Where should your Alert Limit and Action Limit be set?

blocks.zh: 需要通知 QA 嗎？
blocks.en: Does QA need to be notified?

blocks.zh: 提示：如果你的 Normal Operating Range 設定為 ≤ 1.0 μS/cm，Alert Limit 為 1.0 μS/cm，Action Limit 為 1.2 μS/cm，那麼 1.2 已經觸發 Action Limit — 即使 USP 限值是 1.3。是的，必須通知 QA 並記錄在批次記錄中。
blocks.en: Hint: if your Normal Operating Range is set at ≤ 1.0 μS/cm, the Alert Limit at 1.0 μS/cm, and the Action Limit at 1.2 μS/cm, then 1.2 has already triggered the Action Limit, even though the USP limit is 1.3. Yes, QA must be notified and the event recorded in the batch record.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用：多客戶水質管理
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application: Water Quality Management for Multiple Clients

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，Design Range vs Operating Range 的概念尤其重要：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, the concept of Design Range vs Operating Range is especially important:

blocks.zh: 系統設計 — 以最嚴格客戶的規格作為 Design Condition
blocks.en: System design - use the strictest client's specification as the Design Condition

blocks.zh: Allowable Operating Range — 以 USP 限值或最嚴格客戶規格為基準
blocks.en: Allowable Operating Range - base it on the USP limit or the strictest client specification

blocks.zh: Normal Operating Range — 設定在 Allowable Range 的 70-80% 處，確保所有客戶的需求都能被滿足
blocks.en: Normal Operating Range - set at 70-80% of the Allowable Range, to ensure the needs of all clients can be met

blocks.zh: Alert/Action Limits — 基於至少 12 個月的歷史數據進行趨勢分析後設定
blocks.en: Alert/Action Limits - set after trend analysis of at least 12 months of historical data

blocks.zh: 這樣即使進水品質有波動，你仍有足夠的緩衝空間，不至於讓任何一個客戶的產品面臨水質風險。
blocks.en: This way, even if feed water quality fluctuates, you still have enough buffer so that no client's product is exposed to a water quality risk.

blocks.zh: 本章摘要
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 水質規格是最大的成本驅動因素 — 在決定技術方案之前，先確定你真正需要的水質等級（2.1）
blocks.en: The water quality specification is the biggest cost driver - before deciding on a technical solution, first determine the water grade you really need (2.1)

blocks.zh: USP 定義兩種法定水：Purified Water（電導率 + TOC）和 WFI（PW 要求 + 內毒素 + 蒸餾/RO）（2.2.1-2.2.2）
blocks.en: The USP defines two compendial waters: Purified Water (conductivity + TOC) and WFI (PW requirements + endotoxin + distillation/RO) (2.2.1-2.2.2)

blocks.zh: 三階段電導率測試是一套遞進式判定邏輯 — 大多數情況在 Stage 1 就可判定合格（2.2.4）
blocks.en: The three-stage conductivity test is a progressive decision logic - in most cases a pass can be determined at Stage 1 (2.2.4)

blocks.zh: TOC ≤ 500 ppb，是有機污染的間接指標；超標尖峰需要正式調查但可基於 SOP 簡化處理（2.2.5）
blocks.en: TOC ≤ 500 ppb is an indirect indicator of organic contamination; excursion spikes require formal investigation but can be handled in a simplified way based on an SOP (2.2.5)

blocks.zh: 微生物取樣必須在使用點，Action Limit 是最低要求，廠商有責任制定更嚴格的標準（2.2.6, 2.3）
blocks.en: Microbial sampling must be done at the point of use; the Action Limit is the minimum requirement, and the manufacturer is responsible for setting stricter standards (2.2.6, 2.3)

blocks.zh: CPP = 直接影響水質的參數，微生物相關參數因「無法即時監控」而格外關鍵（2.4）
blocks.en: CPP = a parameter that directly affects water quality; microbial-related parameters are especially critical because they "cannot be monitored in real time" (2.4)

blocks.zh: cGMP 的核心在管理，不在技術 — 操作維護 > 設備選型；微生物控制是最大挑戰（2.5）
blocks.en: The core of cGMP is management, not technology - operation and maintenance > equipment selection; microbial control is the greatest challenge (2.5)

blocks.zh: 三層範圍：Design Range ⊃ Allowable Operating Range ⊃ Normal Operating Range，搭配 Alert/Action Limit 形成完整的水質監控體系（2.6）
blocks.en: Three-tier ranges: Design Range ⊃ Allowable Operating Range ⊃ Normal Operating Range, together with Alert/Action Limits forming a complete water quality monitoring system (2.6)
